integrity: The infinite classification is proved symbolically from the weighted-projective age formula and the Fernandez age-symmetry criterion. The bundled finite enumeration is a regression check, not a substitute for the proof.
limitations: The theorem treats only the two-heavy family in complex dimension at least three. The dimension-two case and weighted projective stacks with three or more non-unit weights are not classified here.
title: Hard Lefschetz rigidity for two-heavy weighted projective stacks
